relaxed: Bonjour, and welcome. I am so glad you are here. This is French for your work, and we are going to take it one step at a time. There is no rush. A little each day, a few days a week, is all it takes, and it adds up faster than you think. In this first lesson, you will hear the words people use in your field, say them out loud, and try your first short conversation. Do not worry about getting everything right. Listen, repeat, and be kind to yourself. When you are ready, let us begin. Allons-y.
steady: Bonjour, and welcome. I am so glad you are here. This is French for your work, and you have chosen a steady pace: about one lesson a day, five days a week. That is a rhythm you can keep, and keeping it is what makes the difference. In this first lesson, you will hear the words people use in your field, say them out loud, and try your first short conversation. Do not worry about getting everything right. Listen, repeat, and keep going. When you are ready, let us begin. Allons-y.
intensive: Bonjour, and welcome. I am so glad you are here. This is French for your work, and you have chosen the intensive pace: two lessons a day, five days a week. That is demanding, so keep each session focused, and take a short break between lessons. In this first lesson, you will hear the words people use in your field, say them out loud, and try your first short conversation. Do not worry about getting everything right. Listen, repeat, and stay with it. When you are ready, let us begin. Allons-y.
